scripts.build:apk: npx cap sync android && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='android/app/src/main/assets/public/index.html';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const gid=process.env.GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID||'';if(gid){s=s.replace('__GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID__',gid);console.log('Injected Google Client ID');}else{console.error('Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID env var to enable Google Sign-In');}const fk=process.env.FIREWORKS_API_KEY||'';if(fk){s=s.replace('__FIREWORKS_API_KEY__',fk);console.log('Injected Fireworks API Key');}else{console.error('Set FIREWORKS_API_KEY env var to enable AI tutor');}fs.writeFileSync(p,s);" && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
